ABOUT THE ROLE
 
We are seeking a hands-on, technically fluent engineer to drive the adoption of AI across our entire development organization - someone who finds the friction in how teams work and turns it into automated, AI-powered solutions.
As our AI Enablement Engineer, you will embed with engineering and product teams to identify where AI can remove repetitive, manual work, then build and ship the solutions that make it happen. You will work closely with our AI Efficiency Architects and AI Evangelist to turn high-level AI strategy into concrete, measurable wins on the ground.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys variety, moves fast, and gets real satisfaction from seeing their work adopted and relied upon by teams across the company.
 
Your Mission
Accelerate how the entire development organization works by finding high-impact use cases for AI, building the solutions that automate them, and spreading those wins so they scale across teams.
 
 
 
YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:
 

Use Case Discovery: work directly with engineering and product teams to map their workflows, spot repetitive or slow processes, and identify the highest-impact opportunities for AI-driven automation across the development organization.
Rapid Prototyping & Delivery: act as a builder - lead the technical design and implementation of working solutions such as prompt workflows, lightweight agents, scripts, and integrations that prove value fast, then partnering with the AI Efficiency Architects to harden anything that needs to run in production.
Reusable Enablement Assets: create templates, playbooks, and repeatable patterns so a proven AI win can spread from one team to many without bespoke work each time.
Adoption & Measurement: drive genuine adoption of AI tooling across teams and tie every solution back to concrete outcomes - time saved, throughput, and delivery speed - so impact is visible and quantifiable to leadership.
Feedback to the Platform: surface recurring needs and friction back to the AI Efficiency Architects, so the internal AI gateway and tooling evolve toward what teams actually need.
Technical Mentorship & Influence: mentor senior engineers on AI best practices and influence engineering roadmaps.

 
 
OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:
 
ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Staff-Level Engineering Foundations: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience (Java, Python, Go, or TypeScript) with a proven track record of delivering complex, distributed systems in a production environment.
Production-Ready AI Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience moving AI from a cool prototype to a real-world tool. You don’t just write basic prompts - you know how to build reliable agents and RAG workflows, and you understand the practical side of LLMs, like managing costs, speed, and context limits to make tools actually work for production.
Strategic Problem-Solving: You have a strong bias for action and can take a vague problem and turn it into a working solution fast. While you focus on delivering value quickly rather than chasing perfection, you always think big - building smart, reusable tools that fix root problems for hundreds of developers, not just one team.
Collaboration & Communication: excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work alongside many different teams, understand their needs, and bring them along on the adoption journey.
SDLC/DevOps Familiarity: working knowledge of the tools that underpin the software delivery lifecycle (e.g., GitLab/GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, source control) so that solutions fit naturally into how teams already work.
Self-Direction: capacity to manage a varied portfolio of work across multiple teams, prioritize for impact, and deliver with minimal supervision.

 
NICE TO HAVES

Excellent presentation and training skills
Previous experience running enablement, developer experience, or internal tooling initiatives

 
 
WHO WE ARE
 
At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.
 
 
BENEFITS
 

Hybrid work policy
4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
30 annual vacation days
Occupational Pension
5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually
Parental Leave Top-Up
Possibility to enrol in a private health care insurance for both you and your partner
1,500 SEK equipment allowance
Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts

 
In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!
 
Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!
 
**As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please**

Take Ownership of Building Semin's Presence in the Nordic Market
Semin Group is investing in the Nordic market, and we're looking for someone who wants to be at the centre of that growth. As one of Europe's leading manufacturers of fillers, joint compounds and interior finishing solutions, Semin has built a strong presence across multiple European markets. We are now looking for a National Sales Developer to help establish and grow our business across the Nordic region.
This is a role for someone who enjoys building relationships, creating opportunities and developing business in the construction industry. You'll be responsible for introducing the Semin brand, developing customer relationships and building a strong market presence across Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland. While your activities may initially be focused on your local market, your role will contribute to Semin's growth across the Nordics.
If you enjoy being out with customers, developing new business and taking ownership of your results, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity
Your mission is simple: Build Semin's position across the Nordic region.
While your initial activities may be concentrated in your local market, your responsibility will extend across Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland. You will identify new business opportunities, develop relationships with key customers and distributors, and help establish Semin as a recognised partner throughout the Nordic construction industry.
You will have significant freedom to shape your approach, influence market development, and create new business opportunities across the region. Working closely with colleagues across Europe, you'll play a direct role in strengthening Semin's Nordic presence and supporting the company's continued international growth.

Your Responsibilities

Identify and develop new business opportunities

Build relationships with distributors, builders' merchants, wholesalers and key decision-makers

Introduce Semin's products and solutions to the market

Win new customers and grow existing business opportunities

Visit customers and maintain a strong presence in the field

Represent Semin at industry events, trade fairs and exhibitions

Develop and execute your own business development strategy

Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline

Monitor market trends, customer needs and competitor activity

Work closely with international colleagues to support growth and customer success

Who We Are Looking For
You understand how the construction industry works. You know how to build relationships, identify opportunities and convert them into business. Most importantly, you enjoy creating something new rather than simply maintaining what already exists.

We believe you have:

At least 3 years of B2B sales experience within the construction industry

A proven track record in new business development

Experience working with distributors, builders’ merchants, wholesalers or related sales channels

A strong network within the construction sector

Experience managing your own territory and customer relationships

Excellent communication skills in English

Fluency in Swedish or Danish

A valid driving license

Meritorious

Experience introducing products or brands into new markets

Experience selling fillers, drywall systems, construction chemicals, insulation

products or similar solutions

Experience working in an international organisation

Experience working remotely and independently

You'll Succeed in This Role If You

Enjoy meeting customers and building relationships

Are motivated by finding and winning new business

Take initiative and work well independently

Are resilient and comfortable overcoming obstacles

Enjoy travel and spending time in the field

Have an entrepreneurial mindset

Want to have a direct impact on business growth

This role involves extensive travel and regular customer visits. Success comes from being visible in the market, understanding customer needs and building long-term relationships.

What Semin Offers
At Semin, you'll join a successful European manufacturer while enjoying the autonomy and influence often associated with a much smaller business.

You will receive:

The opportunity to build and develop a market with significant growth potential

Real ownership and responsibility

Direct access to international decision-makers

Product and company training in France

A dedicated mentor during onboarding

Support from experienced colleagues across Europe

An international working environment

A competitive compensation package

The opportunity to play a visible role in Semin's future growth in the Nordic region

Location
The position is home-based and can be located in Sweden or Denmark.
The successful candidate will initially focus on developing Semin's position within their local market while working closely with colleagues across Europe.

Ready to Build Something?
If you're excited by the opportunity to develop a market, build strong customer relationships and play a visible role in a growing international business, we'd love to hear from you.
Please submit your CV in English.
Join Semin and help establish the next chapter of our Nordic growth journey.

INDGEN

Give your career a new dimension

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.

Your tasks:
Your main responsibilities will be the following:
- Provide routine and emergency care
- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software
- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff
- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")
- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations
- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications
- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff
- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register
- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards
- Carry out workstation assessments
- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees
- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentation

Your profile:
- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)
- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".
- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.
- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).
- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.
- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.
- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.
- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.

What we offer:

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/34. This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) - operates Europe's leading research facility for basic research with neutrons in Grenoble (France). The passion for progress and technology unites us and makes innovation in science and research possible every day. Let's work together to change our society and our world for the better.

www.ill.eu/careers

At Catalytic Technology, we help our customers transform ideas into successful products. We work with electronics, embedded software, FPGA design, system engineering and technical project leadership across a wide range of industries.
We are a small and highly experienced team of engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges and working closely with our customers. As demand for our expertise continues to grow, we are looking for an Electronics Engineer to strengthen our Gothenburg office.
About the role
As an Electronics Engineer at Catalytic, you will play a key role in developing advanced embedded and electronic systems. You will be part of a journey where we transition from traditional consulting to inhouse product development.
Your key responsibilities will be:
Electronics architecture and system design
Schematic capture and component selection
Design verification and validation, including board bring-up

We believe you have
MSc or BSc in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems or a related technical field
Several years of experience in electronics development
Experience with schematic design and PCB development
Enthusiasm for using different AI-tools, but you don't depend on them
Good understanding of digital electronics
Experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analysers and spectrum analysers
Strong communication skills in English

The following are considered valuable merits:
PCB design and layout
Embedded software development in C/C++
FPGA or programmable logic experience
EMC and compliance testing
Mixed-signal and/or power electronics design
Industrialisation and production transfer experience
Experience from industrial, telecom, automotive, defence or medical applications

What we offer
At Catalytic, you become part of a highly skilled engineering team.
We offer:
A small company environment with short decision paths
Experienced colleagues with broad engineering expertise
Opportunities to influence technical direction and company growth
Flexible working conditions

About Catalytic Technology
The people at Catalytic Technology develop electronic and embedded products from concept to production. We combine expertise in systems engineering, FPGA development, embedded software, electronics design and project management to help customers bring innovative products to market.

Your role
Do you want to play a key role in ensuring that customers and our global Service organization have access to the right spare parts at the right time?
 
As a Spare Parts Specialist, you will bridge product development and aftermarket operations by managing spare parts information throughout the product lifecycle. Working with a global portfolio of primarily mechanical products, you will collaborate with Engineering, R&D, Service, Supply Chain, and Product Management to ensure high-quality spare parts data, strong aftermarket readiness, and continuous improvement of our processes and tools. 
 
What you will do:
Maintain and develop spare parts information throughout the product lifecycle
Create and maintain technical documentation, product structures, exploded-view illustrations, and recommended spare parts lists
Support new product introductions and ensure aftermarket readiness
Perform spare parts pricing based on defined pricing formulas and principles
Support the global Service organization with technical spare parts expertise
Drive improvements in data quality, digital tools, and ways of working 

 
You will become part of a global organization where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning drive our success. This is an opportunity to make a real impact on customer support, spare parts availability, and the future development of our aftermarket business.
 
Your skills and experience
 
An engineering degree or equivalent technical experience, preferably within mechanical engineering
Experience from spare parts, aftermarket, service, technical support, engineering, or a related field
The ability to understand technical drawings and product documentation
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
A structured and collaborative way of working
Experience with SAP, Salesforce, Windchill, or similar systems is an advantage
Fluency in English 

Your job location
This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our office in Stockholm, Sweden (SE).
 
Application process
Our selection process includes interviews, skills assessments and a background check. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us.

Join our customer in Ludvika and play a key role in optimizing long-term production plans within a highly complex manufacturing environment.
About the role
As a Master Planner, you will support the planning organization by developing the long-term production plan. You will collaborate closely with operations, project management, engineering, and sales to align customer demand with capacity.
We offer a dynamic role in a global and highly collaborative environment where you can directly influence large-scale industrial projects and optimize critical production processes.
Work tasks
The role entails aligning customer demand, project requirements, and production capacity to ensure a smooth and optimized manufacturing flow.
Develop, maintain, and continuously evaluate the master production plan.  
Balance demand, capacity, and production constraints across the entire manufacturing facility.  
Identify long-term bottlenecks, risks, and planning conflicts, driving scenarios to support decision-making.  
Coordinate planning activities across departments to align priorities and production sequences.  
Monitor changes and deviations affecting the long-term plan and recommend corrective planning actions.

We are looking for
Advanced knowledge in production planning, master scheduling, or scheduling within a complex manufacturing environment
Good understanding of capacity planning, production flows, and bottleneck management
Advanced knowledge of Excel and strong analytical skills
Fluent in English, both written and spoken

It is meritorious if you have
Good knowledge of Swedish
Experience with engineer-to-order or project-based manufacturing

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Stress tolerant
Orderly
Responsible
Intellectually curious
Respectful

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Job description:
We are looking for a Fullstack Developer for our client of electric vehicles. You will be part of a team that develops complete energy and charging solutions for electric vehicle users around the world. As a Full-Stack Developer, you will play a key role in developing the digital tools that support our home charging ecosystem both dashboard and portal.  You will join a collaborative, self-organized cloud development team, working primarily with .NET and AWS. Your work will span the full stack, contributing to secure, scalable, and user centric cloud solutions that enhance the everyday experience of EV users and installers globally. In this role, you will: 
• Build and refine backend and frontend features for core digital applications
• Create and integrate scalable, cloud native services
• Enhance system performance, reliability, and usability
• Work closely with developers, testers, and the broader EV team 
• Take initiative, communicate openly, and bring creativity to solving complex problems We value curiosity, independence, and the drive!
 
Skills required:
You are an experienced Fullstack Developer skilled in:
Backend: .NET, C#, AWS, Kafka, SQS/SNS, ECS with Fargate, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB 
Frontend: React, React Remix/SPA, Vite, TanStack Query 
Cloud: AWS management and DevOps practices 
Fluent in English both written and spoken (Swedish is a plus)
A Swedish driver’s license (B) is a huge benefit
Experience required:
• Integrating complex systems in cloud environments
• Familiarity with cloud security in distributed systems 
• Event driven architectures
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC), ideally with Pulumi 
• You have 5+ years of work experience preferably within the automotive industry
• Minimum a bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in SW/IT
Soft skills:
You work analytically and in a structured way. You see continuous testing and quality assurance as essential parts of development. You thrive in collaborative, dynamic environments and enjoy working in diverse, international teams. You are curious, open and helpful to the team. You have excellent communicational skills and can easily collaborate cross-functionally.

jobs.occupation: Extra Staff – Housekeeper/Cleaner at Carotte Housekeeping, Gothenburg
jobs.description:

Carotte currently consists of three companies: Housekeeping, Food & Event, and Staff. Together, we provide comprehensive solutions for everything related to food, meetings, and service for our clients. The group was founded in 1982 and has offices in Stockholm, Jönköping, and Gothenburg.
Carotte Housekeeping is one of the fastest-growing companies within the Carotte Group and the cleaning industry. For us, Housekeeping means taking office cleaning to the next level. We provide high-quality cleaning services with a focus on the overall office environment.
We currently work with several clients who require these types of services, while also recognizing a growing market demand for a high-quality cleaning company. Our vision is to raise standards within the industry and deliver first-class housekeeping services to corporate clients in Stockholm, Jönköping, and Gothenburg.
ABOUT THE POSITION
Main Responsibilities
We are looking for Housekeepers/Cleaners to join Carotte Housekeeping in Gothenburg.
In this role, you will work at our clients' premises, carrying out a variety of cleaning tasks. We are looking for individuals interested in part-time positions at our exciting client locations. Working hours vary and include mornings, daytime, and evenings.
Full Job Description
We are looking for someone who takes pride in creating clean, welcoming, and pleasant environments for our clients.
You are motivated by quality and customer satisfaction. You are detail-oriented, responsible, efficient, service-minded, and have a keen eye for detail. You have a positive attitude and always strive to exceed customer expectations.
You are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
Previous experience in commercial cleaning or similar work is required, as well as knowledge of Swedish or English.

We look forward to receiving your application! Please apply by clicking the "Apply Now" button.
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
Please note that we do not accept applications via email. However, if you have any questions or need further information, please feel free to contact us at mirey@carotte.se.

We are looking for a Diagnostics Engineer for our client of commercial vehicles.

This work requires a wide understanding of the complete platform, such as dependencies between functions and how end-user will interact with the tool and vehicle on aftermarket.  Key Responsibilities:
•	Develop Diagnostic Service Tool (both test and calibration) Operations
•	Develop fault tracing steps  
•	Collaborate with cross-functional teams to create optimal solutions for aftermarket
•	Verify operations at test rig & complete vehicle
•	Develop troubleshooting strategy for DTCs and symptoms that are considered relevant for machine/components within area of responsibility
•	Contribute actively in an Agile development environment

•	Minimum 4–5 years of hands-on experience in Embedded Software,  within the automotive industry
•	 Work Experience with Grade-X or aftermarket diagnostics tools and aftermarket technology is a must

•	 Strong background in complete vehicle level
•	 Ability to read, analyze, and implement engineering specifications
•	 Previous experience working in an Agile team setup

We schedule interviews on a rolling basis so do not wait until end date.
You will work 100% onsite in Gothenburg

We are currently looking for a Customer Adaptation Engineer within Chassie for our client of commercial vehicles.

·       Innovative, driven and a real doer

We are looking for individuals who has:

jobs.occupation: Process Excellence Support in Logistics for BSH Northern Europe
jobs.description:
BSH Home Appliances is a global leader in the home appliance industry, committed to creating innovative solutions that enhance the quality of life at home. Provide first line support for system bugs and process gaps
Analyze data and carry out direct observations to identify root causes and opportunities
Map processes, create flow charts and gap analyses to define improvement scope
Lead and execute "system and process changes", "new implementations", and "optimization initiatives"
Coordinate and communicate with internal and external stakeholders
Identify and initiate AI and automation opportunities

YOUR PROFILE
Degree in industrial engineering or similar
Foundation knowledge in logistics including warehouse and transport processes
Analytical ability, agile and proactive mindset with excellent problem‑solving skills
SAP-S4 Hana: transport management system - TMS/TM invoicing, last mile control - LMC, warehouse management - WM/EWM, forklift management – ITM, track and trace system – GTT, data tables, interfaces, EDI/API connection, carrier connector
Experience leading continuous improvement projects and applying AI/advanced analytics
Proficient in office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, Power BI)
Fluent in English, Nordic language is a plus

Application
For more information about the role, please feel free to contact Sercan Eminoglu, Head of Process Excellence, mailto:sercan.eminoglu@bshg.com. We welcome applications on an ongoing

jobs.occupation: DevOps Operations Azure Devops& CI/CD - 20839 - Uppsala län/Stockholms län
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a DevOps Operations / Platform Support Engineer to support software development teams in the Uppsala region.
The role focuses on Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, development platforms and engineering tools. You will provide hands-on platform support, troubleshoot technical issues and improve operational efficiency through automation, documentation and self-service solutions.
You will collaborate with software developers, architects and DevOps specialists to improve platform reliability, quality and software delivery processes.
What You Will Work On
Support development teams in their daily use of Azure DevOps and related platform services.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving CI/CD pipelines, build environments and development tools.
Monitor platform health and identify recurring technical issues.
Drive corrective actions and continuous improvements.
Automate manual workflows and operational processes.
Improve technical documentation and develop self-service solutions.
Collaborate with developers, architects and DevOps engineers.
Contribute to scalable DevOps practices and engineering standards.
Improve the reliability and efficiency of software delivery platforms.

What You Bring
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps.
Experience designing, maintaining or supporting CI/CD pipelines.
Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Bash or Python.
Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills.
Experience working closely with software development teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Fluent Swedish and English, both spoken and written.
